ModMetaData.name: TicksPerSecond - 1.6
ModMetaData.author: Defi
ModMetaData.description:
Add actual ticks per second to the information display above the pause/speed controls.
This is an update to [GMT]TicksPerSecond 1.5, so that it also works with 1.6.
Be sure to place this towards the bottom of your load order
Original Mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2874527504
